
  ╭─────────────────────────────────────────────╮
  │  /job  (/jobs, /cron)                       │
  │  Scheduled Jobs                             │
  ╰─────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  Summary:
    Manage scheduled cron jobs.

  Usage:
    /job
    /job add
    /job remove   (pick from a list)
    /job pause    (pick from a list)
    /job resume   (pick from a list)
    /job run      (pick from a list)

  Details:
    Schedules recurring commands (cron-style). Every action works
    without an id — you get a picker of your jobs:
    
      • (no args)   — List all scheduled jobs
      • add         — Create a new scheduled job
      • remove      — Delete a job
      • pause/resume— Toggle a job without deleting it
      • run         — Run a job immediately
    
    Jobs the agent schedules for you (via the schedule_task tool)
    show up here too — they share one store.

  Examples:
    $ /job
    $ /job add
    $ /job run

  Related: /background  /telegram
